theorem construction_equation_two (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    ∃ (S : ℕ) (c C : ℝ), 0 < c ∧ 0 < C ∧
      ∃ (b : ℕ), 0 < b ∧ ∃ t₀ : ℕ, ∀ t : ℕ, t₀ ≤ t →
        ∃ Cir : Circuit (ForrelationCoord k t), CircuitRealises Cir (P k t) ∧
          Cir.size ≤ S * mValue t * (2 * t) ^ 2 ∧
          (Q (totalise (Fkm k t Cir)) : ℝ) ≤
            C * Real.sqrt (mValue t : ℝ) * (Real.logb 2 (mValue t : ℝ)) ^ b ∧
          c * Real.rpow (mValue t : ℝ) (2 - 1 / (k : ℝ)) /
              (Real.logb 2 (mValue t : ℝ)) ^ 2 ≤
            (R (totalise (Fkm k t Cir)) : ℝ)

theorem construction_bs_comparison_chain (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∃ t₀ : ℕ, ∀ t : ℕ, t₀ ≤ t →
      (Lvalue k t : ℝ) ≤ (mValue t : ℝ) ^ (1 - 1 / (k : ℝ)) /
        (Real.logb 2 (mValue t : ℝ)) ^ 2 ∧
      (mValue t : ℝ) ^ (1 - 1 / (k : ℝ)) /
          (Real.logb 2 (mValue t : ℝ)) ^ 2 <
        c * (k : ℝ) ^ (-29 : ℤ) *
          ((mValue t : ℝ) / Real.logb 2 ((k : ℝ) * (mValue t : ℝ))) ^
            (1 - 1 / (k : ℝ))

        And
          (LE.le (↑(QuarticQuery.Lvalue k t))
            (HDiv.hDiv (HPow.hPow (↑(QuarticQuery.mValue t)) (HSub.hSub 1 (HDiv.hDiv 1 ↑k)))
              (HPow.hPow (Real.logb 2 ↑(QuarticQuery.mValue t)) 2)))

              (HPow.hPow (Real.logb 2 ↑(QuarticQuery.mValue t)) 2))
            (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul c (HPow.hPow (↑k) (-29)))
              (HPow.hPow (HDiv.hDiv (↑(QuarticQuery.mValue t)) (Real.logb 2 (HMul.hMul ↑k ↑(QuarticQuery.mValue t))))
                (HSub.hSub 1 (HDiv.hDiv 1 ↑k)))))

theorem quantumTournament_list {cc : ℕ} {a : BitInput ι → Col → Col → ℝ}
    (hm : 2 ≤ Fintype.card Col) (hc : ∀ x, IsComparison (a x))
    (hcmp : ∀ i p, Samples cc fun x b => bern (a x i p) b) :
    let m := Fintype.card Col
    let T := Tval m
    let ε := epsval m
    ∃ law : BitInput ι → QuantumCandidateList Col T → ℝ,
      Samples (T * quantumStageReads m T cc ε) law ∧
      Runs (T * stageCost m T cc ε) law ∧
      (∀ x o, 0 ≤ law x o) ∧
      (∀ x, ∑ o, law x o = 1) ∧
      ∀ x s, Dominant (a x) ε s →
        1 - 2 * (m : ℝ) / 2 ^ T - T * ε ≤ ∑ o : QuantumCandidateList Col T, if s ∈ o.1 then law x o else 0

source.type_text:
QuarticQuery.Paper.quantumTournament_list {ι Col : Type} [Fintype ι] [Inhabited ι] [Fintype Col] [DecidableEq Col]
  {cc : Nat} {a : QuarticQuery.BitInput ι → Col → Col → Real} (hm : LE.le 2 (Fintype.card Col))
  (hc : ∀ (x : QuarticQuery.BitInput ι), QuarticQuery.Tournament.IsComparison (a x))
  (hcmp : ∀ (i p : Col), QuarticQuery.Upper.Samples cc fun x b => QuarticQuery.Upper.bern (a x i p) b) :
  have m := Fintype.card Col;
  have T := QuarticQuery.Tournament.Tval m;
  have ε := QuarticQuery.Tournament.epsval m;
  Exists fun law =>
    And (QuarticQuery.Upper.Samples (HMul.hMul T (QuarticQuery.Paper.quantumStageReads m T cc ε)) law)
      (And (QuarticQuery.Upper.Runs (HMul.hMul T (QuarticQuery.Upper.stageCost m T cc ε)) law)
        (And (∀ (x : QuarticQuery.BitInput ι) (o : QuarticQuery.Paper.QuantumCandidateList Col T), LE.le 0 (law x o))
          (And (∀ (x : QuarticQuery.BitInput ι), Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun o => law x o) 1)
            (∀ (x : QuarticQuery.BitInput ι) (s : Col),
              QuarticQuery.Tournament.Dominant (a x) ε s →
                LE.le (HSub.hSub (HSub.hSub 1 (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul 2 ↑m) (HPow.hPow 2 T))) (HMul.hMul (↑T) ε))
                  (Finset.univ.sum fun o => ite (Membership.mem (↑o) s) (law x o) 0)))))

    [Fintype Col] [DecidableEq Col] {cc : ℕ} {a : BitInput ι → Col → Col → ℝ}
    (hm : 2 ≤ Fintype.card Col) (hc : ∀ x, IsComparison (a x))

          ∑ o : QuantumCandidateList Col T, if s ∈ o.1 then law x o else 0

theorem classical_transcript_conditional_expectation {β : Type}
    (T : OutTree (Fin r × κ) β) (f : PartialBool κ)
    {μ : Fin r → BitInput κ → ℝ} (hμ : ∀ j x, 0 ≤ μ j x)
    (τ : ClassicalTranscript r κ) (L : ℕ) (h : Fin r) (q : κ)
    (hm : 0 < ∑ V : Fin r → BitInput κ,
      if classicalPrefix T τ V then ∏ j, μ j (V j) else 0)
    (hc : classicalQueriesTo τ h < L) :
    (∑ U : Fin r → BitInput κ,
      ((if classicalPrefix T τ U then ∏ j, μ j (U j) else 0) /
        (∑ V : Fin r → BitInput κ,
          if classicalPrefix T τ V then ∏ j, μ j (V j) else 0)) *
        (∏ j, classicalTranscriptValue f μ (τ ++ [((h, q), U h q)]) L j)) ≤
      ∏ j, classicalTranscriptValue f μ τ L j

    (∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ ∀ (t : ℕ) (η : ℝ), 0 < η → η < 1 / 2 →
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (L : BitInput (ForrelationCoord k t) → Bool → ℝ)
        (Z : Type) (instZ : Fintype Z),
        let _ := instZ
        ∃ (o : Z) (out : Z → Bool)

          ((2 * (n * k) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ A * (1 + Real.log (1 / η)) ∧
          IsCirc (n * k) F ∧
          (∀ z b, L z b = lawOf (F z (rket o)) out b) ∧
          (∀ z, 0 ≤ L z false ∧ 0 ≤ L z true ∧ L z false + L z true = 1) ∧
          (∀ z b, P k t z = some b → 1 - η ≤ L z b) ∧
          ∃ instI : Inhabited (ForrelationCoord k t),

            ∃ (w : ℕ) (emb : Z ↪ Fin (w + 1))

              ∀ next, (K next).queryCap ≤ 2 * (n * k) + next.queryCap ∧
                ∀ z ψ b, (K next).outputMass z (clEmb emb ψ) b =

    (∃ S : ℕ, 0 < S ∧ ∀ t : ℕ, 1 ≤ t → ∃ C : Circuit (ForrelationCoord k t),

## 3. The proof mechanism and actual dependency order

The partial function \(P_{k,m}\) is quantumly cheap on its promise and classically hard. Its exact Boolean circuit has a diff
to: g discrepancy is less than \(1/3\), contradicting an algorithm correct with probability \(2/3\) on both coupled classes [baseline CL-simulator through CL-randomized-contradiction].

    (w : Col → ℝ) {a : Col → Col → ℝ} (ha : IsComparison a)

    (∑ p, (w p / W) * ∑ i, w i * a i p) =

    (1 / W) * (∑ p, ∑ i, w p * w i * a i p) =
        (W ^ 2 - ∑ i, w i ^ 2) / (2 * W) ∧
    (W ^ 2 - ∑ i, w i ^ 2) / (2 * W) ≤ W / 2

theorem quantumTournament {ι Col : Type} [Fintype ι] [Inhabited ι]
    [Fintype Col] [DecidableEq Col] {cc : ℕ} {a : BitInput ι → Col → Col → ℝ}
    (hm : 2 ≤ Fintype.card Col) (hc : ∀ x, IsComparison (a x))
    (hcmp : ∀ i p, Samples cc fun x b => bern (a x i p) b) :
    let m := Fintype.card Col
    let T := Tval m
    let ε := epsval m
    ∃ C : ℕ, ∃ law : BitInput ι → QuantumCandidateList Col T → ℝ,
      (C : ℝ) ≤ 6072 * (cc : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (m : ℝ) *
        (T : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log (T : ℝ) ∧
      Samples (T * quantumStageReads m T cc ε) law ∧
      Runs C law ∧
      (∀ x o, 0 ≤ law x o) ∧
      (∀ x, ∑ o, law x o = 1) ∧
      ∀ x s, Dominant (a x) ε s →
        1 - 2 * (m : ℝ) / 2 ^ T - T * ε ≤
          ∑ o : QuantumCandidateList Col T, if s ∈ o.1 then law x o else 0
